request.prompt: Single isolated furniture sprite for a high-quality 2D pixel-art RPG set in a contemporary New York investment/software office. Orthographic elevated FRONT view, camera about 35 degrees downward, zero perspective convergence, parallel horizontal tabletop front/back edges, vertical legs, no diagonal isometric rotation. Rich restrained pixel art, warm walnut, charcoal metal, soft muted teal details; crisp 2-3 pixel clusters, dark thin outline, consistent even indoor light. Show whole object centered on solid pure magenta #ff00ff background, no floor, no wall, no people, no cast shadow beyond footprint, no readable lettering. Furniture fits an adult waist height, broad rather than tall. A compact settlement reconciliation desk with two differently colored document trays, closed ledger, small office calculator and a modest desktop monitor. Every item sits firmly on the desk surface. Two solid side supports.
